limitations: Regularisation is not claimed to improve probability calibration
Owned cases overlap players/outcomes; no IID precision/confidence inference
Calendar surprises count as nonappearances at that origin, not necessarily injury mistakes
Mean forecast errors do not establish season-policy superiority; original fullmanager/nativeforecaster comparisons remain separate
forecast_diagnostics.next_fit_policy: Require a distinct diagnosed mechanism and declared chronological development/audit before training; no current inspected-outcome parameter search or automatic promotion

policy_accounting.repeat_scope: Descriptive repeat drift versus earlier released control paths; wall-time-bounded searches and explicit native-admission source differences mean these are not a controlled noise distribution or an extra primary test. Final study uses the uniform fresh controls, never retrospective best controls.
policy_accounting.scope: Post-result accounting on matched independent policy paths; roster/chip/captain changes interact. Component totals are not causal recoverable gains, forecast calibration or a parameter-search mandate.

selection_dependence_stress.scope: Fixed .25 common-uniform appearance mixture preserves marginals. These are chosen-plan expected objective values, not realised gains, probability calibration, an adaptive correlated-policy replay or a newly selected stress parameter.

operational_compatibility.origin_clock_kind: Explicitly invented future origin onehour after a genuine artifact-existence observation; not a live/source capture or historical timestamp
operational_compatibility.scope: Actual approved artifact save/load/interface and legal-horizon mechanical compatibility on invented data only; no current FPL player prediction, accuracy evidence or account/team action

policy_qualification.scope: Optional reviewed experimental decision support only; weights and normal weekly defaults unchanged

limitations: Two reused historical years, not untouched evaluation or four independent seasons
Common no-Assistant-Manager subset in 2024/25; seasonal scoring and rule differences retained
Common openings test management, not a fresh initial-squad builder
Appearance sidecars use fixed 1% regularisation, a conditional-mean identity, independence and no predicted card-only event; these are assumptions, not learned calibrated news probabilities
Raw Brier is slightly better than regularised Brier; no appearance-accuracy improvement is claimed
The new policy uses prior-head appearance marginals while controls rank mean proposals; this compares policies and use of inputs, not pure inner-solver superiority
Inner MILPs still optimise their original mean proxy; expected-value/global bounds unknown
Native paid-transfer canonicalisation is explicit adapted admission; the legacy default remains strict
Original three complete paths and one failure are retained separately; the final sixteen-case matrix uniformly uses the revised source without best-run selection
No new Dastan/OpenFPL/AIrsenal forecaster/fullmanager comparison; their previous separate studies retain scopes
Publisher capture/publication/corrected-source and earlier-than-deadline observation limitations inherited
Nominal outerbudget may finish a started inner solve; actual path timings retained
Lightweight audits/synthetic compatibility/tests/docs overlapped serial batch; not isolated hardware benchmark or extra model fit
